notes.title: QoL Improvement And More Update! (V0.10.0)
notes.notes:
How have you been? 
Here at Brave Alice, we've been deep in the refactoring mines, focusing on improving RPGS and making it better.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42809959/349547d8ff5b977083aff3701d15df19ad90926e.png

We've tackled many quality-of-life improvements and bug fixes, but the highlight of this update is a rework on the visual quality of the app. We weren't satisfied with our current presentation and weather system, so we recently decided to improve it. One thing led to another, and we ended up replacing the entire system.While we initially planned this update to mark our V1 release, with these new additions we’ve decided to continue refining RPGS further.

Wrath of Devs Expansion
With that said we are excited to focus on our next priority which is to start delivering The Wrath of Devs Expansion to our wonderful backers starting with the KitBash packs, billboard add-ons, and new dice sets.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42809959/827fd9614c1057e154941c34bd35d8bc6eec972e.png

 Steam’s Summer Sale 
Also Don’t miss our participation in Steam’s Summer Sale on June 27th, where you can get RPGS at a 30% discount, along with the Unlock Player Seats DLC.

Bloodlines
Lastly, don't miss out on our friends at Story Forge's latest Kickstarter campaign, Bloodlines
A fantastic opportunity to get 7 deadly quests and a collection of unique 3D printable STL minis crafted by US.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42809959/99ba26a6272fc47e7b3279c77f3092d27e627039.png
Check it out here:
Bloodlines Revamped: A D&D 5e Adventure With Bite!


Onwards with the Change log:
New Sky and Weather system :
Our refined system not only looks gorgeous but it also supports sky boxes giving us a lot of creative options. We've removed weather types like pollen and leaves and added them as separate particles in VFX Layer so you can localise and combine them and we also added 3 new customisation options :

 Weather
 Types of Sky (like regular, alien, etc.)
 Aurora

Features:

 Add 5x5ft floors of all types
 Lock Layers
 Lock Object 
 Added a User manual with everything you need to use RPGS
 Move the Camera Up and Down with Ctrl + Q , E
 Working Level now get stored in each environment
 You can search the whole RPGS collection library
 New Collection sorting type by alphabetical and Database order 
 New Collection sorting order (normal, reverse)
 Collection Custom Tags search are now saved in the project
 Improved All Thumbnails
 Improved UI Animations
 Added new Quality Setting Ultra
 All Quality settings have been re balanced.
 Added Change Log in applications
 Updated the credits 

Ruler Improvements:

 Permanent Rulers are now saved in project 
 Permanent Rulers are now sync in Multiplayer
 Can now be individually deleted
 Rules use player colour.

Grid Improvements:

 Fix bug where diff quality setting did not show the Grid
 Grid is now Sync in Multiplayer

Journal improvements:

 Fixed issues where long notes did not scroll to top
 Selection of journal tab is now highlighted

Fixes:

 Fixed bug in Mass placement where undo did not work properly
 Fixed bug in mass placement window did not load properly 
 Fixed weird issue where duplicated group with a character was braking the object properties window
 Fixed issue where sometimes the workshop link did not work.
 Fixed issue with fow where you could see through it 
 Fixed issue where notes created in other level did not work properly
 Fixed issue in settings where resolution appeared twice if you have more than one screen
 Fixed various visual bugs

notes.title: Player Version Release! (V0.6.0.80b)
notes.notes:
GameMasters, it's time to beckon your adventurers to embark on new epic quests! 
Share the magic, unravel the mysteries, and weave epic tales with your friends within the enchanting realms of the wondrous worlds you have crafted.

For the players, our latest update introduces the Player Version, granting you access to join any session created by GM’s and choose any character to represent you. The Player Version also includes a limited edition of the world builder, allowing you to experiment with the creation process. If it feels right, you can upgrade to the GM Version anytime through Steam or our website.


Product Changes.

The release of this version was an adventure of its own, involving intricate setup to support multiple versions in the Steam Store. We won't delve into the technicalities, but moving forward, RPG Stories has the Player Version as its base. The world-building and hosting functionalities are available through the GM Version DLC.

Starting today, everyone who owns RPGS should find both the Players Version and the GM Version DLC in their library.

To our Kickstarter Backers, Player version keys will be dispatched on this Monday/Tuesday and Player seats are currently in development and will be delivered soon.


May your adventures be legendary!

notes.title: Multiplayer Update! (V0.5.0.775b)
notes.notes:
With this release we bring multiplayer only to the GM version but our next update will be solely focused on completing the players version and finally share Your Stories with everyone.

After that things will only get better! With more frequent updates and the with community on our side to guide us about future features and the overall direction of the RPGS.



Current Multiplayer Features

For Now, the Game Masters can do the following:

Decide which environment tab the players see.
Add Spawn Points for the players in these environments.
Force the camera to a certain position for all players.
Add colliders to shape the pathfinding of the player characters.
Use the world-builder in session.
Add VFX live.
Move all characters, NPCs, and monsters.
Add/remove Fog of War.
Roll the dice.
Use the pinpoint tool, the pen tool, the spells, and the measure when needed.


For Now, the Players can do the following:

Join the GM’s game.
Choose the character they want from our collection of models.
Name their character.
Adjust the number of the character’s HP and update in session.
Move their character in the GM’s environment.
Force the camera to track their character.
Change the model of the character during the game (Polymorph players will love this!).
Roll dice.
Open and close the chat, text, or check your party's roll dice.
Use the pinpoint tool, the pen tool, and the measure when needed.



To get you started you can watch the following tutorial posted below.
Also later today join us for a for a presentation Stream at 22:30 CET where I'll go through the multiplayer features and show you some tips on how to setup and run a game.

https://www.twitch.tv/rpgstoriesvtt/

notes.title: Góðan Dag Everyone, Update V0.3.8.590b is here!
notes.notes:
As we press forward in our quest for the VTT Era, we inevitably come across numerous adversaries and monsters along the way.
Among them is the Lag Troll, a formidable opponent. To combat its effects, we have made some refinements and optimizations to our app.

Our primary objective is to prevent any commands or actions from causing the app to freeze, such as loading an environment. By implementing certain changes, we have enabled asynchronous processes to handle these tasks more efficiently.

Please let us know how these modifications have impacted your experience. Your input is invaluable to us.


And of course Moar Content! 

Log cabins and wooden houses
Viking props and weapons
New Medieval floors and walls
2 new scifi floors
1 mud ground and floor
RPGS team characters: Rexal the Hobgoblin and Gamarassaur


And Code Changelog for my beloved super nerds that do want to know!-) 

Improved and Optimized Database system.
World Build optimization and improvements.
World Build “Async” loading:
	-Object don't all load at the same time but rather gradually,
        -Added a small tween to the object when loaded so they don't Just Pop Into existence (do you like it?)
Improved and Async Custom Objects load (Have you noticed that when refocusing the app it freezes for a bit? That should be smoothed out now)



Join us tomorrow for a livestream at 11:00 AM Pacific Time (PT) where we will provide an overview of our latest update and delve deep into the world of RPGs for newcomers. Veterans, please join us as well and share your world-building tips with us! 

RPG Stories Twitch Channel

notes.title: New Update with many new faces in the realm of RPGS! (V0.3.3.545b)
notes.notes:
Yes, indeed! We have populated RPGs with an additional 174 new characters, bringing the total count to 488. You now have a wide selection of NPCs to populate your environments with, or choose them as playable characters in the upcoming VTT Version. And there's more to come! We have even more characters in the pipeline for our next release.


Content Change Log:
New characters:

Fantasy: 88
Modern: 61
Scifi: 25

14 New object from modern era

App Change Log:
We added a new feature in our Collection Browser to assist you in navigating our extensive library. Now, when you enter a keyword in the search field, you can simply press enter, and that keyword will be added as a permanent search parameter.
You can add multiple keywords and Unlike the search field that narrows down your results, this tool will merge the results, allowing you to create personalised 'Pallets' of content.
The tags are also toggleable, making them a convenient way to quickly access your most frequently used search terms. Additionally, you can exclude certain results by adding an exclamation mark '!' at the beginning of your search terms.

Please watch this mini quick tutorial to help out with the explanations:
[previewyoutube=PZ2TWnIWgMw;full][/previewyoutube]


We also fixed some Bug Fixes and did some spell checks!-)

Hello Adventures, a new RPGS Version is up!

This week we have:

The app automatically saves your working project every  few minutes.
The save interval time can be defined in settings

 Revised Scaling of the World 
After some discussion of distances and spaces we did an investigation about our world scaling and did some revisions. Hopefully things look better now!

 New Doors and windows
 Added Fires in fireplaces (extra objects)
 Added Some sci fi Temple stones
 Added Transparent ground so you don't have toggle the ground no more
 Added a new Weather type that has no light and shadows for interior/ underground maps
(sky box still needs tuning!-)

 New  Short Cuts ( - + resize Selection, [] Rotate Selection,"L" toggles LUT Layer)
 Fixed issue when reloading the same project 
 Fixed Issue with rules not getting removed when changing tabs
 Fixed Note Icon to have emission so it's visible in the dark.
